description:
PT Mahakarya Pangan Lestari adalah produsen makanan ringan dan bumbu instan yang berdiri sejak 2009 di Yogyakarta, dengan jaringan distribusi ke lebih dari 1.200 toko di Jawa dan Bali. Seiring pertumbuhan bisnis, kami membuka kesempatan bagi lulusan baru untuk bergabung di tim Finance & Accounting.

Posisi: Staf Akuntansi Junior
Lokasi: Kantor pusat, Sleman, Yogyakarta (work from office, Senin–Jumat)

Tanggung Jawab:
- Mencatat transaksi harian (penjualan, pembelian, kas, dan bank) ke dalam sistem akuntansi
- Melakukan rekonsiliasi bank serta rekonsiliasi piutang dan utang setiap bulan
- Memeriksa kelengkapan dokumen pendukung sebelum pembayaran ke vendor
- Membantu proses closing bulanan dan penyusunan laporan keuangan
- Membantu persiapan data untuk audit eksternal dan pelaporan pajak bulanan (PPN dan PPh)
- Mengarsipkan dokumen keuangan secara rapi, baik fisik maupun digital

Kualifikasi:
- Pendidikan minimal S1 Akuntansi dengan IPK minimal 3,00
- Fresh graduate dipersilakan melamar; pengalaman magang di KAP atau bagian keuangan menjadi nilai tambah
- Memahami siklus akuntansi dan dasar-dasar PSAK
- Menguasai Microsoft Excel (VLOOKUP, pivot table)
- Terbiasa menggunakan software akuntansi seperti Accurate atau Zahir
- Memiliki sertifikat Brevet A & B lebih diutamakan
- Teliti, jujur, dan mampu bekerja dengan tenggat waktu
- Bersedia bekerja di Sleman, Yogyakarta

Yang Kami Tawarkan:
- Gaji pokok Rp4.500.000 – Rp5.500.000 per bulan
- BPJS Kesehatan dan BPJS Ketenagakerjaan
- THR dan bonus tahunan sesuai kinerja perusahaan
- Makan siang di kantor
- Program pelatihan internal dan jenjang karier yang jelas

Cara Melamar:
Kirimkan CV terbaru, transkrip nilai, dan pas foto ke rekrutmen.mahakaryapangan@example.test dengan subjek: Staf Akuntansi Junior – Nama Lengkap. Lamaran paling lambat kami terima pada 30 November 2026. Hanya kandidat yang lolos seleksi administrasi yang akan dihubungi.

Tentang Rangkai
PT Rangkai Solusi Digital membangun aplikasi manajemen sekolah dan pesantren yang saat ini dipakai lebih dari 400 lembaga pendidikan di Indonesia. Tim engineering kami berjumlah 18 orang dan bekerja secara hybrid dari kantor Malang.

Kami mencari Junior Backend Developer yang ingin belajar membangun sistem yang dipakai ribuan guru, orang tua, dan siswa setiap hari.

Tanggung Jawab:
- Mengembangkan dan memelihara REST API untuk aplikasi web dan mobile
- Menulis query SQL yang efisien dan merancang skema database bersama engineer senior
- Menulis unit test dan integration test untuk fitur yang dikerjakan
- Melakukan code review dan menerima review dari anggota tim lain
- Membantu menangani bug produksi bersama tim on-call (dengan pendampingan)
- Menulis dokumentasi teknis untuk API yang dibuat

Kualifikasi:
- S1 Teknik Informatika, Ilmu Komputer, atau bidang terkait (fresh graduate dipersilakan)
- Memahami salah satu bahasa backend: Node.js (TypeScript), Go, atau PHP
- Memahami dasar database relasional (PostgreSQL atau MySQL), termasuk indeks dan join
- Terbiasa menggunakan Git
- Pernah membuat proyek backend (tugas akhir, magang, atau proyek pribadi) yang bisa ditunjukkan
- Nilai tambah: pengalaman dengan Docker, Redis, atau message queue
- Mau belajar, terbuka terhadap masukan, dan nyaman bertanya

Benefit:
- Gaji Rp6.000.000 – Rp8.000.000 per bulan (tergantung hasil technical test)
- Hybrid: 3 hari di kantor, 2 hari remote
- BPJS Kesehatan, BPJS Ketenagakerjaan, dan asuransi kesehatan swasta
- Laptop kerja
- Budget belajar Rp3.000.000 per tahun
- Program mentoring 1-on-1 dengan senior engineer selama 6 bulan pertama

Proses Rekrutmen:
1. Seleksi CV
2. Technical test (take-home, 3 hari)
3. Interview teknis dan diskusi hasil test
4. Interview dengan Head of Engineering

Cara Melamar:
Kirim CV dan link portofolio atau repository ke karier.rangkai@example.test dengan subjek Junior Backend Developer. Info lengkap tentang kami ada di https://rangkai.example.test

About Bumi Rasa Foods
Bumi Rasa Foods makes ready-to-cook spice pastes and sambal sold in 900 supermarkets and online across Indonesia. We are a team of 120 people in Surabaya with a small, hands-on marketing team of five.

The role
As Marketing Associate, you will support campaigns from idea to launch and learn every part of consumer marketing, from social media to in-store promotions. This is an entry-level role suited to recent graduates.

Responsibilities
- Plan and schedule social media content with our content creator and agency
- Coordinate product launches and in-store sampling events with the sales team
- Track campaign results and prepare a short weekly performance summary
- Research competitors, pricing and consumer trends
- Manage relationships with micro-influencers and community partners
- Support the brand manager with briefs, presentations and budget tracking

Requirements
- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications or a related field
- 0–2 years of experience; internships and student organisation roles count
- Good written English and Indonesian, as you will write briefs and captions in both
- Comfortable with spreadsheets and basic analytics
- Experience with Canva or similar design tools is a plus
- Organised, curious and happy to get hands-on at events

What we offer
- Competitive salary based on experience
- Health insurance and BPJS
- Monthly product allowance
- Mentoring from our brand manager and a clear path to Brand Executive within two years

How to apply
Send your CV and a short note (max 150 words) about a campaign you admire and why to careers.bumirasa@example.test. Applications close on 15 December 2026.

PT Cahaya Prima Distribusindo adalah perusahaan distribusi produk kebutuhan rumah tangga dengan 4 gudang dan sekitar 450 karyawan di wilayah Jabodetabek. Kami sedang mencari HR Generalist untuk memperkuat tim Human Capital di kantor pusat Bekasi.

Tanggung Jawab:
- Mengelola proses rekrutmen end-to-end untuk posisi staf dan operasional (posting lowongan, screening, interview awal, hingga offering)
- Mengelola data absensi, lembur, dan cuti karyawan serta memastikan data payroll akurat sebelum diproses
- Mengurus administrasi BPJS Kesehatan dan BPJS Ketenagakerjaan, termasuk pendaftaran, mutasi, dan klaim
- Menyusun kontrak kerja (PKWT/PKWTT), surat peringatan, dan dokumen kepegawaian lainnya
- Menangani onboarding dan offboarding karyawan
- Menjadi tempat konsultasi pertama bagi karyawan terkait kebijakan perusahaan dan hubungan industrial
- Menyiapkan laporan HR bulanan (turnover, headcount, dan biaya lembur)

Kualifikasi:
- Pendidikan minimal S1 semua jurusan, diutamakan Psikologi, Manajemen SDM, atau Hukum
- Pengalaman minimal 2 tahun di bidang HR/personalia, diutamakan di perusahaan distribusi, manufaktur, atau logistik
- Memahami UU Ketenagakerjaan dan peraturan turunannya, termasuk ketentuan PKWT dan pesangon
- Terbiasa mengurus payroll dan BPJS
- Mahir Microsoft Excel; pengalaman menggunakan HRIS menjadi nilai tambah
- Komunikatif, tegas, dan bisa menjaga kerahasiaan data
- Domisili Bekasi dan sekitarnya

Benefit:
- Gaji Rp6.500.000 – Rp8.000.000 per bulan
- Tunjangan transport dan makan
- BPJS Kesehatan dan BPJS Ketenagakerjaan
- THR dan bonus tahunan
- Cuti tahunan 12 hari

Cara Melamar:
Kirim CV dan ekspektasi gaji ke hc.cahayaprima@example.test dengan subjek HR Generalist – Nama. Kandidat yang sesuai akan dihubungi melalui WhatsApp atau email dalam 2 minggu.

About Rakit Commerce
Rakit Commerce provides order management and fulfilment software for 3,000 online sellers in Indonesia. Our platform processes around 400,000 orders a day across marketplaces, social commerce and sellers' own websites.

The role
We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join the Orders & Inventory team. You will own services that sit on the critical path of every order, and help us move from a large Go monolith to well-bounded services without slowing down product delivery.

What you will do
- Design, build and operate backend services in Go with PostgreSQL and Kafka
- Lead technical design for new features, write design documents and review those of others
- Improve the reliability and performance of high-traffic APIs, especially during campaign peaks
- Define and track SLOs, and take part in a fair on-call rotation
- Mentor mid-level and junior engineers through code review and pairing
- Work closely with product managers to shape scope and trade-offs

What we are looking for
- 4+ years of backend engineering experience, with at least 2 years in Go
- Strong PostgreSQL skills: query tuning, indexing, partitioning and safe schema migrations
- Experience with event-driven systems (Kafka or similar) and patterns such as outbox and idempotency
- Experience running services in production on Kubernetes or a similar platform
- Good observability habits: metrics, tracing and structured logs
- Clear written communication in English
- Nice to have: experience in logistics, payments or e-commerce

What we offer
- IDR 30,000,000 – 42,000,000 per month, plus an annual bonus
- Hybrid work: two days a week in our South Jakarta office
- Private health insurance for you and your family
- Learning budget and conference leave
- Employee stock options

How to apply
Apply with your CV at https://rakit.example.test/careers or email engineering.rakit@example.test. Our process: a 30-minute recruiter call, a technical interview about a past project, a system design interview, and a final conversation with the VP of Engineering. We aim to finish within three weeks.

Kopi Nalar adalah brand kopi susu asal Bandung dengan 34 gerai di Jawa Barat dan penjualan online di berbagai marketplace. Kami percaya kopi enak harus bisa dinikmati semua orang, dan media sosial adalah tempat utama kami ngobrol dengan pelanggan.

Kami mencari Social Media Specialist yang paham tren, suka data, dan bisa bikin konten yang bukan sekadar estetik tapi juga menjual.

Tanggung Jawab:
- Menyusun content plan bulanan untuk Instagram, TikTok, dan X sesuai kalender promo
- Membuat brief konten untuk desainer dan videografer, serta ikut produksi konten di gerai
- Mengelola iklan berbayar di Meta dan TikTok bersama tim performance
- Memantau komentar, DM, dan mention, lalu berkoordinasi dengan tim CS untuk keluhan pelanggan
- Menganalisis performa konten dan iklan, kemudian membuat laporan mingguan beserta rekomendasi
- Bekerja sama dengan KOL dan komunitas lokal untuk kampanye peluncuran menu baru

Kualifikasi:
- Pendidikan minimal D3/S1 Ilmu Komunikasi, Pemasaran, atau bidang terkait
- Pengalaman minimal 1–2 tahun sebagai social media specialist atau digital marketing, diutamakan di F&B, fashion, atau lifestyle
- Berpengalaman mengelola Meta Ads atau TikTok Ads dengan budget minimal Rp30 juta per bulan
- Paham metrik seperti reach, engagement rate, CTR, CPC, dan ROAS
- Bisa menggunakan Canva dan CapCut; kemampuan editing video pendek menjadi nilai tambah
- Melampirkan portofolio konten atau akun yang pernah dikelola

Benefit:
- Gaji Rp5.500.000 – Rp7.000.000 per bulan + bonus pencapaian KPI
- BPJS Kesehatan dan BPJS Ketenagakerjaan
- Jatah kopi gratis setiap hari kerja
- Lingkungan kerja santai dan diisi anak-anak muda

Cara Melamar:
Kirim CV dan portofolio ke halo.kopinalar@example.test dengan subjek Social Media Specialist. Lowongan dibuka sampai posisi terisi.

About Kencana Mart Group
Kencana Mart Group operates 260 minimarkets and 12 supermarkets across Greater Jakarta and West Java, plus a fast-growing grocery delivery app. Our Data & Insights team supports merchandising, store operations, marketing and finance.

The role
As a Data Analyst, you will be the go-to analyst for our commercial and operations teams. You will turn transaction, inventory and app data into dashboards and recommendations that change what we stock, where, and at what price.

Responsibilities
- Build and maintain dashboards for sales, margin, stock availability and promotions
- Analyse promotion and pricing experiments and explain the results to category managers
- Develop demand forecasts for fresh and fast-moving categories with the supply chain team
- Write efficient SQL against our cloud data warehouse and help improve data models
- Partner with stakeholders to define metrics and make sure everyone uses the same definitions
- Present findings to senior leadership in a clear, practical way

Requirements
- 3–5 years of experience as a data or business analyst, ideally in retail, e-commerce or FMCG
- Advanced SQL and working knowledge of Python for analysis
- Experience with a BI tool such as Power BI, Looker Studio or Metabase
- Understanding of A/B testing and basic statistics
- Strong stakeholder management: you can push back politely and explain trade-offs
- Fluent in Indonesian and comfortable working in English

What we offer
- Competitive salary and annual bonus
- Health insurance for you and your family
- Monthly shopping vouchers
- Hybrid work after probation (three days in the office)
- Access to online learning platforms

How to apply
Send your CV to data.careers.kencanamart@example.test with the subject line Data Analyst – Your Name. Shortlisted candidates will complete a short SQL and case exercise before the interviews.

Rimbun Kasir adalah aplikasi kasir dan manajemen stok untuk UMKM, mulai dari warung kopi, toko kelontong, hingga butik. Saat ini lebih dari 25.000 merchant di seluruh Indonesia menggunakan Rimbun Kasir setiap hari.

Kami mencari Customer Success Associate yang sabar, ramah, dan senang membantu pemilik usaha kecil memanfaatkan aplikasi kami sebaik mungkin.

Tanggung Jawab:
- Melakukan onboarding merchant baru melalui video call dan WhatsApp, termasuk setup produk, stok, dan printer struk
- Menjawab pertanyaan dan keluhan merchant melalui chat, email, dan telepon sesuai SLA
- Menghubungi merchant yang jarang aktif untuk memahami kendala mereka dan membantu mereka kembali menggunakan aplikasi
- Mencatat masukan merchant dan meneruskannya ke tim produk
- Membuat dan memperbarui artikel bantuan (FAQ) dan video tutorial singkat
- Mencapai target bulanan untuk aktivasi merchant, CSAT, dan retensi

Kualifikasi:
- Pendidikan minimal SMA/SMK, diutamakan D3/S1
- Pengalaman minimal 1 tahun di bidang customer service, hospitality, retail, atau F&B (pengalaman langsung melayani pelanggan sangat kami hargai)
- Komunikasi lisan dan tulisan yang baik dalam Bahasa Indonesia
- Terbiasa menggunakan komputer, spreadsheet, dan aplikasi chat
- Pernah menggunakan CRM atau sistem ticketing menjadi nilai tambah
- Sabar, punya empati tinggi, dan tidak mudah panik saat menghadapi pelanggan yang kesal

Benefit:
- Gaji Rp5.000.000 – Rp6.000.000 per bulan + insentif bulanan
- BPJS Kesehatan dan BPJS Ketenagakerjaan
- Pelatihan produk dan customer success selama 3 minggu pertama
- Kesempatan berkembang ke posisi Account Manager atau Onboarding Specialist

Cara Melamar:
Kirim CV ke talenta.rimbunkasir@example.test dengan subjek Customer Success Associate – Nama. Kami terbuka untuk pelamar yang sedang beralih karier.

About Pijar Learning Co.
Pijar Learning designs online training for hospitals, banks and manufacturers across Indonesia. Our courses are used by more than 60,000 employees, from frontline staff to supervisors.

The role
We are hiring an Instructional Designer to create engaging, practical e-learning and blended programmes for adult learners. You will work with subject-matter experts, video editors and our learning technologist.

Responsibilities
- Analyse training needs with clients and define clear, measurable learning objectives
- Design course structures, storyboards and scripts for e-learning modules, microlearning and live workshops
- Write scenario-based activities, quizzes and assessments that reflect real job situations
- Build modules in our authoring tool and publish them to clients' learning management systems
- Evaluate course effectiveness using completion data, assessment results and learner feedback
- Keep content accessible, inclusive and consistent with our style guide

Requirements
- Background in education, training, instructional design or a related field
- At least 2 years of experience designing learning, which can include classroom teaching, corporate training or curriculum development
- Familiarity with instructional design models such as ADDIE or SAM and with adult learning principles
- Excellent writing skills in English and Indonesian
- Experience with an e-learning authoring tool, or the willingness to learn one quickly
- A portfolio or samples of learning materials you have designed

What we offer
- IDR 9,000,000 – 12,000,000 per month, depending on experience
- Fully remote within Indonesia, with optional co-working space in Medan
- Health insurance and BPJS
- Annual learning budget and access to design courses

How to apply
Email your CV and two portfolio samples to people.pijarlearning@example.test. Career changers from teaching are warmly welcome: tell us about a lesson you redesigned and what changed for your students.

PT Panen Raya Snack Indonesia adalah produsen makanan ringan dan biskuit dengan merek yang sudah dikenal di Jawa Tengah dan Jawa Timur. Untuk memperkuat penjualan di kanal modern trade, kami membuka lowongan Key Account Executive yang berbasis di Semarang.

Tanggung Jawab:
- Mengelola hubungan dengan key account modern trade regional (supermarket lokal dan jaringan minimarket) di area Jawa Tengah dan DIY
- Mencapai target penjualan bulanan dan kuartalan per account
- Menegosiasikan listing produk baru, trading term, dan program promosi dengan buyer
- Memantau display, ketersediaan stok, dan aktivitas kompetitor di toko bersama tim merchandiser
- Mengevaluasi efektivitas promosi serta membuat laporan sell-in dan sell-out
- Berkoordinasi dengan distributor terkait pengiriman, retur, dan penagihan

Kualifikasi:
- Pendidikan minimal S1 semua jurusan
- Pengalaman minimal 3 tahun sebagai sales di perusahaan FMCG, minimal 1 tahun menangani modern trade
- Memiliki relasi dengan buyer supermarket lokal di Jawa Tengah menjadi nilai tambah
- Memahami perhitungan margin, trading term, dan promosi
- Mahir Microsoft Excel untuk analisis penjualan
- Memiliki SIM C dan kendaraan pribadi
- Bersedia melakukan perjalanan dinas di area Jawa Tengah dan DIY

Yang Kami Tawarkan:
- Gaji pokok Rp7.000.000 – Rp9.000.000 per bulan
- Insentif penjualan bulanan dan bonus tahunan
- Tunjangan transport, bensin, dan pulsa
- BPJS Kesehatan, BPJS Ketenagakerjaan, dan asuransi rawat inap

Cara Melamar:
Kirimkan CV, ekspektasi gaji, dan ringkasan pencapaian target 2 tahun terakhir ke recruitment.panenraya@example.test dengan subjek KAE Semarang – Nama.

Klinik Utama Bunda Sejati adalah klinik utama dengan layanan poli umum, poli penyakit dalam, poli anak, dan unit hemodialisis di Surakarta. Kami melayani pasien umum, asuransi swasta, dan peserta BPJS Kesehatan.

Dibutuhkan segera: Perawat Klinik (2 orang)

Tanggung Jawab:
- Melakukan pengkajian awal pasien (tanda vital, anamnesis singkat, dan skrining risiko jatuh)
- Membantu dokter dalam pemeriksaan dan tindakan di poli serta ruang tindakan
- Melakukan tindakan keperawatan seperti pemasangan infus, injeksi, perawatan luka, dan nebulisasi
- Memberikan edukasi kesehatan kepada pasien dan keluarga, termasuk peserta program penyakit kronis
- Mendokumentasikan asuhan keperawatan di rekam medis elektronik
- Mengelola stok alat kesehatan dan obat emergensi di ruang tindakan
- Mendukung pelaksanaan standar akreditasi klinik serta pencegahan dan pengendalian infeksi

Kualifikasi:
- Pendidikan D3 Keperawatan atau S1 Keperawatan + Profesi Ners
- Memiliki STR aktif dan bersedia mengurus SIP
- Memiliki sertifikat BTCLS/BLS yang masih berlaku
- Pengalaman minimal 1 tahun di rumah sakit atau klinik; pengalaman di IGD menjadi nilai tambah
- Bersedia bekerja dengan sistem shift (pagi, siang, malam)
- Ramah, teliti, dan mampu bekerja dalam tim
- Berdomisili di Surakarta atau sekitarnya

Benefit:
- Gaji Rp4.000.000 – Rp5.000.000 per bulan (di atas UMK Surakarta) + tunjangan shift malam
- BPJS Kesehatan dan BPJS Ketenagakerjaan
- Jasa pelayanan bulanan
- Pelatihan berkala yang dapat digunakan untuk pemenuhan SKP

Cara Melamar:
Kirim surat lamaran, CV, fotokopi STR, ijazah, dan sertifikat BTCLS ke sdm.bundasejati@example.test dengan subjek Perawat Klinik – Nama. Berkas juga dapat diantar langsung ke bagian SDM klinik pada hari kerja pukul 08.00–14.00.

About us
Lantern & Leaf is a small branding studio working with hospitality, food and wellness brands in Indonesia, Singapore and Australia. We are eight people, fully remote, and we care a lot about craft and kind collaboration.

The role
We are looking for a Graphic Designer with around two years of experience to work on brand identities, packaging and social media systems. You will work directly with our creative director and with clients.

Responsibilities
- Develop visual identities, from logo exploration to full brand guidelines
- Design packaging, menus, signage and printed collateral, and prepare files for print
- Create social media templates and campaign visuals that clients can reuse
- Present concepts to clients and explain your design decisions clearly
- Manage several projects at once and meet deadlines without sacrificing quality

Requirements
- 2+ years of professional design experience in an agency, studio or in-house team
- A strong portfolio that shows branding and packaging work, including your process
- Excellent typography and layout skills
- Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop and InDesign; Figma is a plus
- Illustration skills are a bonus
- Good written and spoken English for client communication

What we offer
- IDR 7,000,000 – 9,000,000 per month
- Fully remote, with flexible hours across Indonesian time zones
- An annual studio retreat
- Equipment allowance and a yearly learning budget

How to apply
Send your CV and portfolio (PDF or link) to studio.lanternleaf@example.test. In your email, pick one project from your portfolio and tell us what you would do differently today.

PT Arta Kredit Sejahtera adalah perusahaan pembiayaan (multifinance) yang menyalurkan kredit kendaraan bermotor dan pembiayaan multiguna melalui 38 cabang di Pulau Jawa dan Sumatra. Tim Business Intelligence kami sedang berkembang dan membutuhkan Junior Data Analyst.

Tanggung Jawab:
- Menyiapkan laporan rutin terkait pencairan kredit, kualitas portofolio (NPF), dan kinerja penagihan
- Membuat dan memelihara dashboard untuk manajemen cabang dan kantor pusat
- Menulis query SQL untuk menarik dan mengolah data dari database perusahaan
- Melakukan analisis ad-hoc, misalnya profil nasabah yang menunggak atau efektivitas program promosi
- Membantu memeriksa kualitas data dan berkoordinasi dengan tim IT jika ditemukan anomali
- Menyajikan temuan analisis dalam bahasa yang mudah dipahami tim bisnis

Kualifikasi:
- Pendidikan minimal S1 jurusan Statistika, Matematika, Teknik Informatika, Ekonomi, atau Manajemen
- Pengalaman 0–2 tahun sebagai data analyst; lulusan bootcamp data analytics dipersilakan melamar
- Menguasai SQL dan Excel; memahami Python untuk analisis data menjadi nilai tambah
- Pernah membuat dashboard dengan Looker Studio, Power BI, atau Tableau
- Memahami dasar-dasar statistik
- Pengalaman atau pemahaman di industri perbankan, koperasi, atau pembiayaan menjadi nilai tambah
- Teliti, rapi dalam bekerja, dan bisa menjaga kerahasiaan data nasabah

Benefit:
- Gaji Rp7.000.000 – Rp9.000.000 per bulan
- Bonus tahunan
- BPJS Kesehatan, BPJS Ketenagakerjaan, dan asuransi kesehatan
- Fasilitas pinjaman karyawan
- Pelatihan analitik dan sertifikasi

Cara Melamar:
Kirim CV dan link portofolio proyek data (misalnya dashboard atau notebook) ke bi.recruitment.artakredit@example.test dengan subjek Junior Data Analyst – Nama. Kandidat terpilih akan mengikuti tes SQL dan studi kasus.

About Saku Rantau
Saku Rantau helps Indonesian and Malaysian workers abroad send money home quickly and cheaply. Our app serves 400,000 monthly active users in Singapore, Malaysia, Hong Kong and Taiwan, and we are licensed as a remittance company in Singapore.

The role
We are hiring a Product Manager for our Payments & Compliance squad. You will own the transfer experience end to end, from onboarding and KYC to payout, and balance user experience with regulatory requirements in several markets.

Responsibilities
- Own the roadmap for onboarding, KYC and the money transfer flow
- Run discovery with users, many of whom are domestic and factory workers using the app on low-end phones
- Write clear product requirements and work daily with engineers, designers and compliance
- Design and analyse experiments to improve conversion and repeat transfers
- Work with payout partners in Indonesia and the Philippines to improve speed and success rates
- Track product metrics and present results to leadership every month

Requirements
- 3–6 years of product management experience, ideally in fintech, payments or lending
- A proven track record of shipping features that moved a measurable metric
- Understanding of KYC/AML requirements and how to design compliant flows that remain simple
- Comfortable with SQL or product analytics tools
- Excellent communication in English; Bahasa Indonesia or Malay is a strong plus
- Able to work from our Singapore office at least three days a week

What we offer
- SGD 7,500 – 9,500 per month plus equity
- Medical and dental coverage
- 18 days of annual leave
- A home-country visit allowance once a year

How to apply
Apply through https://sakurantau.example.test/careers or email talent.sakurantau@example.test with your CV and a short note about a product decision you made that you would now make differently.

PT Gemilang Sarana Distribusi adalah perusahaan distribusi suku cadang otomotif dan pelumas dengan gudang utama seluas 12.000 m² di kawasan industri Cikarang. Kami melayani lebih dari 1.500 bengkel dan toko suku cadang di Jawa dan Sumatra.

Posisi: Supervisor Gudang (1 orang)

Tanggung Jawab:
- Memimpin dan menjadwalkan tim gudang yang terdiri dari 2 leader dan sekitar 25 staf (inbound, picker, packer, dan checker)
- Memastikan proses penerimaan, penyimpanan, picking, dan pengiriman berjalan sesuai SOP dan target harian
- Menjaga akurasi stok melalui cycle count rutin dan stock opname berkala

About Arkadia
Arkadia Health Tech builds software that helps clinics, laboratories and pharmacies in Indonesia run their daily operations and share information safely. Our products include a clinic management system used by more than 2,800 clinics, a laboratory information system, and a patient app with 1.5 million registered users for booking appointments, viewing test results and receiving medication reminders. We are a team of about 320 people, including 110 in engineering, product and design, with offices in Jakarta and Yogyakarta.

We raised our Series C in 2026 and are now investing in platform foundations so that our product teams can move faster without putting patient data or system reliability at risk.

The role
We are hiring an Engineering Manager to lead our Platform group. The group currently has three teams and around 22 engineers:
- Developer Platform: CI/CD, internal tooling, service templates and developer experience
- Infrastructure & Reliability: cloud infrastructure, observability, incident response and capacity planning
- Data Platform: event streaming, data pipelines and the analytics warehouse used by product and business teams

You will report to the VP of Engineering and work closely with product, security, data and compliance leaders. This is a people-leadership role first: you will manage tech leads and senior engineers directly, while staying technical enough to guide architecture decisions and hold a high bar for reliability.

What you will do

Lead and grow people
- Manage three tech leads and several senior engineers directly, and support the growth of everyone in the group
- Hire for the group: we plan to add about 10 engineers over the next 12 months, including a staff engineer
- Run regular one-on-ones, give clear and timely feedback, and lead performance reviews and promotions for your group
- Build a team culture where people ask for help early, write things down and share ownership of production

Set direction
- Define and communicate a 12–18 month platform strategy that balances reliability, security, cost and developer productivity
- Turn the strategy into quarterly plans and OKRs with your tech leads, and make trade-offs visible to stakeholders
- Represent the platform group in architecture reviews and leadership forums

Deliver and operate
- Improve delivery performance across engineering, measured with DORA metrics and regular developer surveys
- Own the incident management process, including on-call health, incident reviews and follow-through on action items
- Lead our move from a mix of hand-managed servers to a consistent, infrastructure-as-code setup on a managed Kubernetes platform
- Keep cloud costs predictable and help product teams understand the cost of what they build

Protect patient data
- Work with security and compliance to meet regulatory requirements for health data, including access controls, audit logging, encryption and data residency
- Make secure defaults part of the platform, so product teams get them without extra effort

What we are looking for

Must have
- 8+ years in software engineering, with at least 3 years managing engineering teams, including managing tech leads or other managers
- A hands-on background in backend or infrastructure engineering, and experience with cloud platforms, containers and CI/CD
- A track record of improving reliability or delivery speed in a growing organisation, with numbers to show it
- Experience hiring engineers and building a fair, structured interview process
- Experience running incident management and on-call for production systems with real users
- Clear written communication in English; you will write strategy documents, incident reviews and proposals

Nice to have
- Experience in a regulated industry such as health, finance or insurance
- Experience leading a platform or infrastructure group that serves internal customers
- Experience with event-driven architectures and data platforms
- Experience managing teams across two or more cities
- Fluency in Bahasa Indonesia

How we work
- Engineering teams own their services from design to production
- We write design documents for significant changes and review them asynchronously
- We run blameless incident reviews and track action items to completion
- We prefer small, frequent releases over big launches
- Most teams work in the office on Tuesdays and Thursdays; the rest of the week is flexible

What we offer
- IDR 60,000,000 – 80,000,000 per month, depending on experience
- Employee stock options
- Annual performance bonus
- Private health insurance for you, your spouse and up to three children, including dental and optical cover
- 20 days of annual leave, plus your birthday off
- An annual learning budget of IDR 15,000,000 and paid time to attend conferences
- Hybrid working with a home office allowance
- Paid parental leave beyond the legal minimum

Our hiring process
1. A 30-minute call with our talent partner
2. A 60-minute conversation with the VP of Engineering about your experience as a manager
3. A leadership case study: you will receive a short written scenario about a struggling team and discuss your approach with two engineering leaders
4. A system design and technical judgement interview with a staff engineer
5. A meet-the-team session with tech leads from the platform group
6. A final conversation with our CTO, followed by reference checks

We try to complete the process within four weeks and give feedback after every stage, whatever the outcome.

How to apply
Apply through https://arkadia.example.test/careers or send your CV to engineering.talent.arkadia@example.test with the subject line Engineering Manager, Platform. A cover letter is optional, but we would love to read a few lines about a team you are proud of having built or turned around.

Arkadia is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every background, and we will make reasonable adjustments to our process on request.
